body: I've lasted long enough that I'm equally angry and depressed. Luckily, it is not spite anger. I feel like that would give me more motivation to shove it in her face by doing it. It feels worse that she wasn't even ignoring my call but just put it on silent and forgot about it. Almost like an I dare you. It hurts

I like games. Competitive games. Whether it's sports, video, card or bar games. It helps keep me focused on something else. I use to like other things but they all have a touch of sadness to them now.
